claims.label: INDEPENDENTLY_REVIEWED_AT_ALGEBRAIC_SCOPE
claims.exact_statement: For arbitrary real packet values D_2,...,D_n, define Gamma_m=D_m-D_(m-1)/2 and C_m=2^m D_m. Then for every 2<=t<n, sum_(m=t+1)^n 2^(m-n)(-Gamma_m)=2^-n(C_t-C_n), and D_n plus this signed sum equals 2^(t-n)D_t=2^-n C_t. For the genuine Boolean q_n packet, C_n tends to 4 and C_2 has the exact formula displayed in the report with 4.8676<C_2<4.8677.
hypotheses: physical q_n restriction chain for the endpoint statement
does_not_prove: nonnegativity of the reached signed sum

claims.label: CONDITIONAL_PENDING_NONCONTRIBUTOR_REVIEW
claims.exact_statement: If Gamma_n^D<0 for every n>=3 for the complete physical q_n packet, then C_n strictly decreases to 4, the reached signed sum is nonnegative, it is less than 0.8677*2^-n, and its ratio to the terminal packet is less than 0.1783.
hypotheses: all hypotheses of the reviewed q_n packet
claims.reviewer_recusal: B19 materially contributed the phase-sign dependency and cannot provide fresh end-to-end independent review
